senses.gloss: † 1. लड् and लाड् ला̆ड्, i. 10, ला̆डय, ला̆दापय, Par. To throw up, to blame.

2. लड् लड्, Caus., or i. 10, Par. लडय,
 1. † To loll (the tongue).
 2. To stir with the tongue, Pañc. 229, 20 (but with ल् instead of ड्).
 3. † To use the tongue.
 4. † To apprise, to show.
 5. † To throw out, to be thrown out.
 6. † To coagulate, to pain.
 7. † To suffer pain. The final ड् seems to stand for ल् (cf. लल्).
 --Perhaps cf. λάλος, λαλέω, λῆρος; N.H.G. lallen.
लड्डु लड्डु, A class of sweetmeats, Lass. 2. ed. 59, 5.
लड्डुक लड्डु + क, m. n. A class of [] sweetmeats, Lass. 2. ed. 9, 11; 13; Brahmav. 3, 8. 53.
लाड लाड, m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 226.
